title: IVG Pro 12 Double Mango Prefilled Vape Pod + Refill
description: Double Mango IVG Pro 12 Prefilled Pods deliver a lush, tropical Mango flavour with extra depth and richness. This sweet and juicy profile layers ripe Mango notes to create a satisfying fruit vape with lasting appeal. Each refill pack includes a 2ml pod prefilled with 20mg nicotine salt e-liquid and a separate 10ml refill reservoir. Once clicked together, the system auto-refills the pod as you vape — no messy top-ups or coil changes. Combined, they support up to 10,000 puffs per kit depending on usage. With mesh coil technology and smooth MTL vapour, these pods are made exclusively for the IVG Pro 12 Prefilled Pod Vape Kit . How to Set Up: Remove the red stoppers from the 2ml pod. Twist and remove the red safety cap from the 10ml refill reservoir. Insert the pod into the refill reservoir and press until they click into place. Slide the connected pod and refill unit into the device. Wait a few moments to allow the coil to saturate before vaping.
